summary.zh: 胚珠裸露、不形成果实的种子植物，现存约 1000 余种：银杏、苏铁、松柏类与买麻藤类。
summary.en: Seed plants with naked ovules and no fruit; roughly a thousand living species: ginkgo, cycads, conifers and gnetophytes.

debate.zh: 现存裸子植物是单系群，但买麻藤类在其中的位置（与松科近缘还是与全部针叶树互为姐妹）仍有争议。
debate.en: Living gymnosperms are monophyletic, but the position of gnetophytes (near Pinaceae or sister to all conifers) is still debated.
